model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between #Iteration and Loss for several lines. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels every 20000 units. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4. A purple solid line, labeled "Vanilla (n=64)", begins at a value of approximately 2.93 at 0 iterations and decreases to approximately 2.62 at 140000 iterations. An orange solid line, labeled "StrmLLM (n=64)", begins at approximately 2.98 at 0 iterations and decreases to roughly 2.62 at 140000 iterations. A red solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H)", also begins at approximately 2.98 at 0 iterations and descends to about 2.62 at 140000 iterations. A green solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", starts at around 2.98 at 0 iterations and declines to approximately 2.62 at 140000 iterations. A blue solid line, labeled "SepLLM (n=128)", starts at roughly 2.97 at 0 iterations and falls to approximately 2.62 at 140000 iterations.
